scientific_goal: Reduce held-out one-step innovation autocorrelation for 0p10 while preserving stable long-rollout moments and correcting the mid-frequency POD PSD mismatch.
scientific_constraints: Tune and select only on validation repetitions 13 and 14; keep test repetitions 15 and 16 locked.
Treat held-out innovation ACF, innovation calibration, one-step NLL, rollout stability, moments, and PSD shape as separate evidence.
A useful model must reduce both short-lag and persistent long-lag innovation correlation; moving correlation from selected lags into a long tail is failure.
Use matched structural ablations before scalar tuning and compare network capacity when adding history.
Do not add endpoint-moment losses in this campaign.

Interpret rollout PSD against the process retained by the saved 5 percent training trim. In the center-without-spatial-mean 3.16-10 kHz screening band, the matched clean-reference/untrimmed-reference power ratio is approximately 0.205, so a generated/untrimmed ratio near 0.20 is the relevant target rather than 1.
Request a reviewed implementation when the evidence calls for a model family outside the declared options.
advisor_guidance: The memory-free parent has good stationary moments but colored innovations. PSD screening uses an untrimmed reference even though the model is fitted to the saved 5 percent trimmed process. A matched clean-window diagnostic gives clean/untrimmed power about 0.205 in the controller's center-without-spatial-mean 3.16-10 kHz band (with nperseg 256 rather than the screen's 1024), so do not optimize this ratio toward 1. Judge models primarily by finite-rollout stability, energy and POD moments, innovation ACF and calibration, and adjacent-band PSD shape. Raw-velocity memory and deterministic oscillators did not jointly fix the large positive leading-coordinate innovation ACF. The first autoregressive innovation trial (offsets 1,2,5, rank 4, cap 0.95, multistep weight 0.1) saturated its norm cap mostly at offsets 2 and 5, barely changed innovation ACF, and inflated trimmed-reference energy and covariance to about 1.50 and 1.55. Treat it as a negative high-coupling result. A conservative rank-8, cap-0.25, one-step-only matched ablation is queued to separate insufficient coordinate rank and multistep conflict from failure of the innovation-memory idea.

seed_runs.hypothesis: The short-H2,H5 diagonal damped-residual model is the stable memory-free control.
Sparse same-coordinate velocity-memory taps whiten the remaining innovations without changing the fitted parent dynamics.
A wide raw-history input with the original 64x64 network tests history without capacity matching.
